pr_title: Add option --json  for gh variable list
pr_body:
Fixes #8492 

<!--
  Thank you for contributing to GitHub CLI!
  To reference an open issue, please write this in your description: `Fixes #NUMBER`
-->

```shell
$ go run cmd/gh/main.go variable list --help
List variables on one of the following levels:
- repository (default): available to GitHub Actions runs or Dependabot in a repository
- environment: available to GitHub Actions runs for a deployment environment in a repository
- organization: available to GitHub Actions runs or Dependabot within an organization

For more information about output formatting flags, see `gh help formatting`.

USAGE
  gh variable list [flags]

FLAGS
  -e, --env string        List variables for an environment
  -q, --jq expression     Filter JSON output using a jq expression
      --json fields       Output JSON with the specified fields
  -o, --org string        List variables for an organization
  -t, --template string   Format JSON output using a Go template; see "gh help formatting"

INHERITED FLAGS
      --help                     Show help for command
  -R, --repo [HOST/]OWNER/REPO   Select another repository using the [HOST/]OWNER/REPO format

LEARN MORE
  Use `gh <command> <subcommand> --help` for more information about a command.
  Read the manual at https://cli.github.com/manual
```

```shell
# execute on my fork repo
$ go run cmd/gh/main.go variable list --json name (git)-[feat/variable-list-json-output]   [~/go/src/github.com/w1mvy/cli]
[]
```
pr_comments:
@w1mvy : thank you for opening this PR! ❤️  At first glance, I'm reminded about similarities when support for exporting secrets was done in  #8081 regarding differences in variables at various levels.

So, just trying to correlate that discussion with respect here as it should largely apply.

@samcoe  Thanks for your review and fix!! LGTM 👍 
One small thing. With this change, the key name returned by `gh secret list --json` is going to be changed from snake case to camel case. (But other commands return in camel case, so I do not think this change itself is a problem. I'm thinking it's about the decision to include it in the release notes or not.)
@w1mvy That is a good call out, we can definitely make sure to mention it in the release notes.

### Proposed solution

Useful when using environment variables  in the local environment

### Additional context

review_comments: I would love to see all these export functions in this package moved into their own internal function named `export` or `exportable` one day, but that felt like too big of a refactor to tack onto this PR.
Additionally this name is not the greatest, open to other suggestions.

Could explain why this is needed?

https://github.com/rajhawaldar/cli/blob/976b84afd2ce02bb575df1269baac33a0618ed9b/pkg/cmd/secret/list/list.go#L147-L149

Thanks your review!!

Added to make the return value an empty array.  example `pr list` `issue list`

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/586eb8b865ea539832716a3d8c5cb42b11ee784c/pkg/cmd/pr/list/list.go#L179-L181

```
$ gh pr list --json id
[]
```

However, secret list does not return an empty array. 

`secret list` and `variable list` have similar usage scenarios, it would be better to align their behavior with that of secret list.

```
$ gh secret list --json name
no secrets found
```

Having a getter and setter for the `fields` field felt a bit off but decided this was the quickest way to get this change in. In the future we should evaluate just exporting `jsonExporter` and its fields. Perhaps when doing the refactor I mentioned in the comment below.
